annotation_revisions.quote: 采用侵蚀-生产力评价模型计算的土壤可蚀性因子
annotation_revisions.rationale: 变量定义直接命名获取模型；K与K_EPIC不合并。

annotation_revisions.quote: 基于修正土壤流失方程（RUSLE）计算。
annotation_revisions.rationale: 段落明示模型，公式主输出Q_sr与土壤保持量定义绑定；不推及所有中间量。

annotation_revisions.quote: 采用修正风蚀方程 RWEQ 进行评价。
annotation_revisions.rationale: 同一父来源明示采用模型评价防风固沙量，SR为该量；三个子视图仍归同一train父来源。
年份i对应所用降雨资料，P_i,j,k明示该年第半月逐日降雨量；区别实测输入与推导的R，保留冻结R来源口径。

annotation_revisions.quote: 计算获得的植被覆盖所占像元比例即为该像元的植被覆盖度
annotation_revisions.rationale: 原文完整声明遥感图像像元分解计算流程，FVC是该流程输出；这是明确流程来源，不据此补NDVI土壤/植被端元的直接来源。

validation_policy.checkpoint_selection: minimum loss on the same fixed 70 validation records; no dev-based checkpoint choice
validation_policy.scope: training-source development validation; previously used source, not a new independent test

paired_protocol.effect: reviewed supervision additions; both arms share new candidates, evidence and long views
full_dev_gate: at least one complete expanded method/source path

limitations: Only one model-variable source training parent and one held-out source parent; coverage is a small pilot, not broad generalization.
Assistant source review is not new independent human annotation.
Unresolved endmember sources and method intermediates are not promoted to positives.
